title: Copy List with Random Pointer
summary: Create a deep copy of a singly linked list whose nodes also have a random pointer.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–1,000 nodes with values in [−10,000, 10,000]. The next chain is acyclic. Each random pointer may target any node in the list or be null. A randomIndex of −1 represents null. Other indices are zero-based.

statement: Create a deep copy of a singly linked list whose nodes also have a random pointer. Every copied node must be new, with the same value as its original. Translate both kinds of links to copied nodes and return the copied head. Leave the original list unchanged. The judge supplies the head, while examples show rows [value, randomIndex] in next order.

examples.explanation: The first clone's random pointer targets the second clone.
The one copied node points to itself through random.
Identical values do not change which objects the random pointers target.

constraints: 0–1,000 nodes with values in [−10,000, 10,000]. The next chain is acyclic. Each random pointer may target any node in the list or be null. A randomIndex of −1 represents null. Other indices are zero-based.
hints: Conceptual: Equal values do not tell you whether two pointers target the same node.
Directional: Build a mapping from each original node to its corresponding new node.
Implementation: Allocate all clones before wiring their links. For each original, look up the clones of its next and random targets, leaving null links null.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(n) auxiliary space for a node-to-clone map, excluding the cloned nodes.
